job.title: Staff Security Engineer (Identity & Access Systems)
job.workplace: Hybrid – San Jose, CA office 3 days a week
job.pay_full: $156,800 – $196,000 a year base salary (excludes commission, bonus, equity if applicable, and benefits)

details.about: Zscaler runs the Zero Trust Exchange, a large in-line cloud security platform that protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss. This Staff Security Engineer reports to the Senior Director, Security Compliance, and leads the technical strategy for workload trust and access systems, including non-human identity (NHI) lifecycle management, telemetry and automated service-to-service access controls.
duties: Architect and scale authentication and authorization for distributed services, microservices, API clients and cloud workloads
Run end-to-end non-human identity governance: automated onboarding, secret rotation, dependency tracking and decommissioning for server-to-server clients
Design real-time observability pipelines, dashboards (e.g. Grafana) and alerting for authentication health, rate limits and access anomalies
Automate infrastructure and secrets by building OAuth 2.0, mTLS and SPIFFE/SPIRE into CI/CD and developer self-service tooling
Lead cross-functionally with platform infrastructure, IT and software engineering teams
needs: Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and a history of using new technology to improve workflows
8+ years of engineering experience in security engineering, cloud security, distributed systems, infrastructure/SRE or identity & access management
Deep understanding of AuthN vs AuthZ, token lifecycles (OAuth 2.0 client credentials, OIDC, JWT) and access models (RBAC/ABAC)
Hands-on experience governing machine, workload or service-to-service identities and credentials in cloud environments
Experience designing operational metrics, log aggregation and real-time dashboards (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog)
A track record of aligning security, IT and platform engineering teams
nice: Using AI technologies to drive measurable operational efficiency
SPIFFE/SPIRE and mTLS/private PKI certificate lifecycles
Secrets platforms such as HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or Azure Key Vault
Python, Go or Bash for automating identity workflows and REST APIs
details.benefits: Base salary $156,800 – $196,000 a year, the target range for new hires across all US locations; it excludes commission, bonus, equity (if applicable) and benefits. Benefits include various health plans, vacation and sick time, parental leave options, retirement options, education reimbursement and in-office perks.
notes: Hybrid: in the San Jose, CA office 3 days a week
Reports to the Senior Director, Security Compliance
